{
  "design": {
    "theme": "chalk",
    "picture_style": "illustration"
  },
  "flow": [
    {"slide": 1, "does": "Recall equal sharing and fraction notation", "look_at": {"kind": "none", "shows": null}, "teaches": []},
    {"slide": 2, "does": "Introduce the approved objectives", "look_at": {"kind": "none", "shows": null}, "teaches": []},
    {"slide": 3, "does": "Model finding a unit fraction", "look_at": {"kind": "diagram", "shows": "24 counters shared into four equal groups"}, "teaches": [1]},
    {"slide": 4, "does": "Try a matching unit-fraction calculation", "look_at": {"kind": "none", "shows": null}, "teaches": [1]},
    {"slide": 5, "does": "Model finding a non-unit fraction", "look_at": {"kind": "diagram", "shows": "Three of four equal parts of 24 selected"}, "teaches": [2]},
    {"slide": 6, "does": "Try a matching non-unit-fraction calculation", "look_at": {"kind": "none", "shows": null}, "teaches": [2]},
    {"slide": 7, "does": "Correct dividing by the numerator", "look_at": {"kind": "diagram", "shows": "20 split into four equal parts, with three selected"}, "teaches": [1, 2]},
    {"slide": 8, "does": "Check the divide-then-multiply method", "look_at": {"kind": "none", "shows": null}, "teaches": [2]},
    {"slide": 9, "does": "Model a fraction-of-money word problem", "look_at": {"kind": "diagram", "shows": "Two of five equal shares of £30"}, "teaches": [3]},
    {"slide": 10, "does": "Try a matching money word problem", "look_at": {"kind": "none", "shows": null}, "teaches": [2, 3]},
    {"slide": 11, "does": "Practise quantities and measures with a stretch task", "look_at": {"kind": "none", "shows": null}, "teaches": [1, 2, 3]},
    {"slide": 12, "does": "Apply fractions to a new choice, then complete the worksheet exit ticket", "look_at": {"kind": "none", "shows": null}, "teaches": [1, 2, 3]}
  ],
  "title": {
    "template": "title",
    "heading": "Fractions of amounts",
    "lead": "Recall: 12 sweets are shared equally between 4 children.\nHow many sweets does each child get?\nIn ¾, which number tells us how many equal parts make the whole?",
    "picture": null
  },
  "slides": [
    {
      "template": "equation-hero",
      "heading": "Find ¼ of 24",
      "lead": null,
      "formula": "¼ of 24 = 24 ÷ 4",
      "points": [
        "24 ÷ 4 = 6",
        "¼ of 24 = 6"
      ],
      "figure": {
        "kind": "equal-groups",
        "shows": "24 counters shared into four equal groups to find one quarter.",
        "alt": "Four equal groups each contain six counters.",
        "title": null,
        "total": 24,
        "groups": 4,
        "layout": "rings",
        "show_count": "each",
        "unknown": false
      }
    },
    {
      "template": "practice",
      "heading": "Your turn: one equal part",
      "questions": [
        "Find ¼ of 28.",
        "Write the division you used.",
        "Explain what the denominator tells you to do."
      ],
      "instruction": "Calculate, then explain.",
      "picture": null
    },
    {
      "template": "equation-hero",
      "heading": "Find ¾ of 24",
      "lead": null,
      "formula": "¾ of 24 = (24 ÷ 4) × 3",
      "points": [
        "One quarter: 24 ÷ 4 = 6",
        "Three quarters: 6 × 3 = 18",
        "¾ of 24 = 18"
      ],
      "figure": {
        "kind": "bar-model",
        "shows": "A whole of 24 split into four equal parts, with three parts shaded.",
        "alt": "A bar of 24 has four equal parts of six; three parts are shaded.",
        "title": null,
        "bars": [
          {
            "label": null,
            "whole": 24,
            "parts": 4,
            "values": null,
            "shaded": 3,
            "unknown": "none",
            "unit": null
          }
        ],
        "combined": false
      }
    },
    {
      "template": "practice",
      "heading": "Your turn: several equal parts",
      "questions": [
        "Find ¾ of 28.",
        "Write the division and multiplication you used.",
        "Explain what the numerator tells you to do."
      ],
      "instruction": "Show both steps.",
      "picture": null
    },
    {
      "template": "visual-text",
      "heading": "Which number do we divide by?",
      "lead": "For ¾ of 20, divide by 4, not by 3.",
      "points": [
        "The denominator makes 4 equal parts.",
        "20 ÷ 4 = 5 in each part.",
        "Take 3 parts: 5 × 3 = 15."
      ],
      "figure": {
        "kind": "bar-model",
        "shows": "Four equal parts of 20 demonstrate why the denominator controls division.",
        "alt": "20 is split into four parts of five, with three parts shaded.",
        "title": null,
        "bars": [
          {
            "label": null,
            "whole": 20,
            "parts": 4,
            "values": null,
            "shaded": 3,
            "unknown": "none",
            "unit": null
          }
        ],
        "combined": false
      }
    },
    {
      "template": "hinge",
      "heading": "Choose the answer",
      "stem": "What is ⅗ of 20?",
      "options": ["4", "12", "8", "60"],
      "correct": 2
    },
    {
      "template": "equation-hero",
      "heading": "A fraction of some money",
      "lead": "Mia has £30. She spends ⅖ of it. How much does she spend?",
      "formula": "⅖ of £30 = (£30 ÷ 5) × 2",
      "points": [
        "One fifth: £30 ÷ 5 = £6",
        "Two fifths: £6 × 2 = £12",
        "Mia spends £12."
      ],
      "figure": {
        "kind": "bar-model",
        "shows": "£30 divided into five equal shares, with two shares selected.",
        "alt": "Five equal shares of £6 make £30; two shares are shaded.",
        "title": null,
        "bars": [
          {
            "label": null,
            "whole": 30,
            "parts": 5,
            "values": null,
            "shaded": 2,
            "unknown": "none",
            "unit": "£"
          }
        ],
        "combined": false
      }
    },
    {
      "template": "practice",
      "heading": "Your turn: spending money",
      "questions": [
        "Amir has £40. He spends ⅖ of it. How much does he spend?",
        "Show your division and multiplication.",
        "Write your answer in a sentence with the correct unit."
      ],
      "instruction": "Solve the problem.",
      "picture": null
    },
    {
      "template": "practice",
      "heading": "Fractions in everyday life",
      "questions": [
        "There are 36 apples. ⅙ are green. How many apples are green?",
        "A ribbon is 35 cm long. Eva uses ⅗ of it. How many centimetres does she use?",
        "A bag holds 40 kg of compost. A gardener uses ⅜ of it. How many kilograms does he use?",
        "Stretch: Write a problem in which ⅔ of an amount is 18. Solve it to check."
      ],
      "instruction": "Show your working and include units.",
      "picture": null
    },
    {
      "template": "practice",
      "heading": "Choose enough juice",
      "questions": [
        "Jug A holds 24 litres. It is ⅜ full. How many litres are in it?",
        "Jug B holds 20 litres. It is ½ full. How many litres are in it?",
        "A class needs 10 litres. Which jug has enough juice? Prove your choice."
      ],
      "instruction": "Calculate, then justify your decision.",
      "picture": null
    }
  ]
}
